The '''central ruin of Rhand''' was the primary residence for the [[Way of the Dark|Dark]] organization known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhand]] in the [[Nihil Retreat]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] of the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The structure was first constructed by the [[Unidentified Rhand species|original inhabitants]] of Rhand who had disappeared thousands of years before the foundation of the Sorcerers of Rhand. When the [[Knell of Muspilli]], [[Kanzer Exiles]], and [[Warriors of Shadow]] merged their belief systems in the Nihil Retreat, the greatest of the sorcerers took residence in the ancient ruins on Rhand and dubbed themselves the Sorcerers of Rhand. In [[80 BBY/Legends|80 BBY]] a [[Historian/Legends|chronicler]] from [[Carrivar]] named [[Succate]] ventured to the central ruins of Rhand to learn more about the Sorcerers. In the ruin's [[Rhandite receiving chamber|receiving chamber]], Succate was harassed and intimidated by Rhandites in various states of disassembly and decay.
